hypothesis: Difficult valid machining-generated material states can be separated into conventional advanced-B-rep strategies where STEP semantics are structurally adequate, while cases whose faithful output would require changed body/contact/empty semantics can be isolated as explicit blockers without healing, fusing, dropping, triangulating or tolerance-collapsing material.
falsification: The screen fails if any required obstruction class has neither a qualifying native witness nor an explicit blocker; if a proposed route changes nominal material, durable body identity or lineage; if mesh/faceted wrapping is treated as engineering success; if exact-zero and positive-volume neighbours are collapsed by tolerance; or if MC-C is promoted without complete native output and downstream-consumer evidence.

standards_sources.claim: advanced_brep_shape_representation restricts representation items to advanced B-rep-compatible items and requires at least one MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP or MAPPED_ITEM; the item set is not restricted to one solid.
manifold_solid_brep represents its outer boundary as one CLOSED_SHELL.

brep_with_voids is a manifold_solid_brep with one or more oriented closed-shell voids; its informal propositions require void shells to be disjoint from the outer shell and each other and enclosed by the outer shell.

native_witness.fact: 32 successful STEP-required exact-strategy attempts wrote and freshly re-read AP242DIS millimetre B-rep within the historical campaign budgets.
native_witness.scope: bounded historical RCS-011 exact-strategy cases only; not universal material correctness

requirements: closed shell
advanced faces/trim structure as required by selected AP profile
fresh readback
independent comparison to nominal material

obstruction_classes.name: enclosed-disjoint-cavity
obstruction_classes.boundary_kind: one outer closed shell with one or more disjoint enclosed void shells

native_witness.fact: No source-bound machining-generated native STEP witness satisfying this class was identified in the accepted dependencies/historical evidence.

requirements: each void shell closed
each void shell disjoint from outer shell and other void shells
each void shell enclosed within outer shell
native write/read and consumer validation

obstruction_classes.name: multiple-disconnected-positive-volume-components
obstruction_classes.boundary_kind: two or more disconnected regular positive-volume material components

native_witness.fact: The historical cut-through control preserved body_count=2 in the independent oracle, directional candidate and external comparator, but did not establish native STEP representation plus independent engineering use.
native_witness.scope: material/body witness only, not qualifying STEP output witness

strategy.step_form: multiple MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP items in one ADVANCED_BREP_SHAPE_REPRESENTATION
requirements: one faithful solid item per retained durable material body unless a reviewed profile specifies otherwise
no fusion at zero-volume contact
body/lineage binding survives write/read
independent consumer preserves component meaning

obstruction_classes.name: positive-micro-bridge-or-sliver
obstruction_classes.boundary_kind: positive-volume connection or remnant arbitrarily close to the requested resolution boundary

native_witness.fact: The 1 um plunge retained positive physical removal while the historical external comparator explicitly refused resolution-qualified authority; RCS-012 also records a positive 1 um cusp erased by coarse occupancy.
native_witness.scope: boundary/material witness; no qualifying native STEP witness

strategy.step_form: ordinary analytic/certified MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP when topology is regular
requirements: positive material cannot be rounded to zero
writer/sewing tolerances must be bounded below the certified feature separation for that case
fresh read preserves component/connectivity/material witnesses

obstruction_classes.name: exact-zero-point-or-edge-contact
obstruction_classes.boundary_kind: distinct regular material regions touching only at point or edge with zero volumetric bridge

native_witness.fact: No qualifying machining-generated native STEP/consumer witness was found for the exact-zero contact semantics required by MC-1.

strategy.step_form: candidate decomposition into multiple MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP items only if MC-054 approves contact/body semantics
requirements: do not add a positive bridge
do not fuse durable bodies merely because shells touch
preserve exact-zero contact as distinct from positive bridge and positive gap
consumer path must preserve the approved interpretation

obstruction_classes.name: touching-cavity-or-cavity-to-exterior
obstruction_classes.boundary_kind: void boundary touches another void or the exterior at a singular set

native_witness.fact: No qualifying machining-generated native STEP/consumer witness was found; BREP_WITH_VOIDS informal propositions require disjoint enclosed void shells.

strategy.step_form: no accepted single BREP_WITH_VOIDS route for the touching state; decomposition/grouped-solid alternative requires MC-054
requirements: preserve nominal void/material set
no artificial internal face or positive wall unless physically present
consumer interpretation must be explicit

obstruction_classes.name: singular-pinch-or-self-contact
obstruction_classes.boundary_kind: non-manifold boundary singularity such as pinch/self-contact generated by a physically valid machining history

native_witness.fact: No qualifying machining-generated native STEP/consumer witness was found for a faithful conventional engineering mapping of this singular class.

strategy.step_form: decomposition/grouped-solid or other conventional profile only after MC-054 defines semantics
requirements: material set unchanged
durable body/lineage semantics explicit
no singularity healing by arbitrary tolerance
independent consumer evidence

obstruction_classes.name: empty-material
obstruction_classes.boundary_kind: valid history leaves no positive-volume workpiece material

native_witness.fact: No qualifying native STEP/consumer witness exists for the explicit MC-1 empty-output contract.

strategy.step_form: explicit empty engineering-output outcome outside nonempty MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP success semantics
requirements: retain durable exhausted-body/lineage record in programme authority
do not fabricate a residual solid
do not count an empty placeholder STEP as successful nonempty export
MC-054/MC-017 define and test downstream empty handling

blockers.summary: No source-bound machining-generated native STEP witness plus independent consumer evidence for BREP_WITH_VOIDS cavity output.
Multi-solid STEP is structurally expressible but durable-body mapping and independent consumer preservation are not natively qualified.
No qualifying native STEP write/read witness demonstrates preservation of a certified positive micro-feature at the MC-1 boundary; historical external comparison refused the 1 um case.
Exact-zero contacts, touching cavities and singular pinches require an explicit MC-054 output-profile decision plus independent-consumer evidence; healing or tolerance fusion is forbidden.
Empty-material engineering-output semantics are not yet qualified; a fake residual solid or placeholder STEP is not acceptable.
